labels.reason: Historical reviewer: Three categories all flagged incorrectly: (1) real email headers with documented send times ('date: Fri, Jan 23, 2009 at 11:42 AM') -- these are literal metadata, not fabricated; (2) specific times in memoir/business narrative recounting real events ('6:30 pm board meeting', '5:30pm office') -- genuine recollections; (3) idiomatic time references ('paged at 4:00 AM', 'stay up till 4:00 AM') -- common colloquial usage. The rule cannot distinguish fabricated AI timestamps from real or idiomatic time references.
